kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Preassembled motor, feedback and control cables for energy-chain motion.
intro.zh: 用于拖链运动的预制电机、反馈与控制电缆。

intro.en: Drag-chain cable materials for motion-specific configuration.
intro.zh: 针对运动工况配置的拖链原线材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Define travel, speed, acceleration and expected cycle duty.
copy.zh: 定义行程、速度、加速度及预期循环工况。

copy.en: Check the selected cable diameter and minimum moving bend radius against the chain.
copy.zh: 结合拖链核对所选线缆外径与动态最小弯曲半径。

copy.en: Match the actual drive interface, pin map and conductor construction.
copy.zh: 匹配实际驱动接口、针脚定义与导体结构。

copy.en: Set separation, free movement and strain relief at the fixed and moving ends.
copy.zh: 确定线缆分隔、自由运动空间以及固定端和移动端的应力释放。

copy.en: Review temperature, oil, chips and enclosure conditions before choosing the jacket.
copy.zh: 选择护套前核对温度、油污、切屑与机壳条件。

copy.en: Agree electrical acceptance and any motion testing needed for the actual installation.
copy.zh: 约定电气验收及实际安装所需的运动测试。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
